criteria.criterion: margin_global_bits_per_decision <= 0.001 (one-sided upper percentile of the paired-by-hand bootstrap of mean(log_loss_hybrid - log_loss_active) on the admission support)
criteria.derivation_rule: ceil_to_quantum(max(MARGIN_MAX_BITS, one_sided_upper_quantile of the paired hybrid-minus-active bootstrap), MARGIN_ANALYTIC_TOLERANCE_BITS)

justification.statement: the margin is sized by the measured TRAIN out-of-fold dispersion: it is the smallest multiple of the preregistered 0.001-bit resolution that covers the observed one-sided 95% upper bound of the paired hybrid-minus-active loss difference, and the closed-form analytic margin reproduces it within the preregistered tolerance
justification.statistic: one-sided upper percentile of the paired-by-hand bootstrap of mean(log_loss_hybrid - log_loss_active) on the TRAIN out-of-fold admission support

criteria.criterion: gain_sparse_bits_per_decision >= 0.167 on the pooled (rare_exact, exact_absent_in_domain) support
criteria.derivation_rule: max(GAIN_FLOOR_BITS, floor_to_quantum(support_weighted_mean of the hybrid channel's gain_bits_per_decision over rare_exact and exact_absent_in_domain, MARGIN_ANALYTIC_TOLERANCE_BITS))

rounding.rationale: the floor is the gain TRAIN already demonstrated, rounded down to the preregistered resolution so the requirement is never stricter than the measured evidence

justification.statement: the minimal sparse gain required of the router is the level the TRAIN out-of-fold evidence already demonstrates on the two strata the generalized channel may cover
justification.statistic: support-weighted mean of the hybrid channel's gain_bits_per_decision over rare_exact and exact_absent_in_domain on the TRAIN out-of-fold decisions

criteria.derivation_rule: min(ECE_ABSOLUTE_CEILING, ece_active_sparse + ECE_DELTA_CEILING) with ece_active_sparse the support-weighted active-reference ECE on the sparse strata

justification.statement: the frozen ceiling is the tighter of the preregistered absolute ECE ceiling and the active reference's own sparse ECE plus the preregistered delta; the recorded term name shows which of the two binds
justification.statistic: support-weighted expected calibration error over rare_exact and exact_absent_in_domain, measured on the TRAIN out-of-fold decisions

criteria.derivation_rule: max(FREQUENT_EXACT_MAX_DEGRADATION_BITS, ceil_to_quantum(max(point estimate, one-sided upper quantile, ci95 upper) of the paired hybrid-minus-active loss on frequent_exact, MARGIN_ANALYTIC_TOLERANCE_BITS))

justification.statement: the frequent-exact route may not degrade the active reference beyond the bound derived from the paired dispersion of that stratum, in point estimate and in paired upper quantile
justification.statistic: paired-by-hand hybrid-minus-active log-loss delta on the frequent_exact stratum of the TRAIN out-of-fold decisions

criteria.criterion: abstain iff hard_reasons is not empty; abstain_rate on the synthetic out-of-domain probe surface == 1.0 and coverage == 0.0
criteria.derivation_rule: abstain(c) iff reasons(c) intersect OOD_HARD_REASONS is not empty; the soft reason set may only raise the status to high uncertainty, never to abstention

justification.statement: the router must fail closed on every out-of-domain probe: the frozen criterion requires a complete abstention on the probe surface, with the hard reason codes decisive and the soft reasons never abstaining
justification.statistic: measured abstention rate of the frozen router on the synthetic out-of-domain probe surface of the TRAIN cross-validation

ood_gate.high_uncertainty_rule: no hard reason and at least one soft reason raises the status to MODEL_SUPPORTED_HIGH_UNCERTAINTY without abstaining

status_definitions.MODEL_OOD_ABSTAIN: the context is out of the calibrated distribution: a never-observed category or a queried sizing / stack / price outside the calibrated TRAIN domain. The gate abstains and no model answer may be used
status_definitions.MODEL_SUPPORTED: the context is inside the calibrated TRAIN domain, every category was observed, the local support is above the calibrated floor and the predictive uncertainty is below the calibrated ceiling: the answer may be used as a supported model output
status_definitions.MODEL_SUPPORTED_HIGH_UNCERTAINTY: the context stays inside the calibrated TRAIN domain and no category is unseen, but at least one uncertainty signal is in its calibrated tail (rare feature label, exact cell never observed in TRAIN, robust domain distance, spline-knot boundary, high predictive entropy or low fitted node support): the answer is still emitted, but it must be reported as a high-uncertainty output

constants.name: NON_INFERIORITY_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL
constants.provenance: preregistered router convention, aligned with the frozen #421 protocol

constants.name: NON_INFERIORITY_UPPER_QUANTILE
constants.provenance: one-sided upper percentile of the paired bootstrap (1 - alpha)

constants.name: NON_INFERIORITY_ALPHA
constants.provenance: preregistered one-sided tail of the paired non-inferiority bootstrap

constants.name: BOOTSTRAP_SEED
constants.provenance: deterministic bootstrap seed of the issue-423 preregistration

constants.name: MARGIN_MAX_BITS
constants.provenance: preregistered maximum tolerated global non-inferiority margin

constants.name: MARGIN_ANALYTIC_TOLERANCE_BITS
constants.provenance: preregistered agreement tolerance between bootstrap and analytic margin

constants.name: GAIN_FLOOR_BITS
constants.provenance: preregistered minimum sparse gain over the global action prior

constants.name: ECE_DELTA_CEILING
constants.provenance: preregistered maximum sparse ECE delta against the active reference

constants.name: FREQUENT_EXACT_MAX_DEGRADATION_BITS
constants.provenance: preregistered non-degradation bound on the frequent-exact route

constants.name: MINIMUM_SPARSE_OBSERVATIONS
constants.provenance: repository minimum-support convention reused for the sparse floor

constants.name: MINIMUM_CATEGORY_SUPPORT
constants.provenance: minimum out-of-fold support before a categorical block may be consumed

constants.name: MINIMUM_POSITIVE_GAIN_SHARE
constants.provenance: minimum eligible support share answered with positive gain

constants.name: FREQUENT_EXACT_MIN_SUPPORT
constants.provenance: stratum threshold reused from the #421 TRAIN cross-validation

constants.name: RARE_EXACT_MIN_SUPPORT
constants.provenance: stratum threshold reused from the #421 TRAIN cross-validation

constants.name: Z_ONE_SIDED_95
constants.provenance: standard normal one-sided 95% quantile used by the analytic margin

formulas.expression: margin_global = quantile(paired_bootstrap(hand_id, B=BOOTSTRAP_SAMPLES, seed=BOOTSTRAP_SEED) of delta = loss_hybrid - loss_active, NON_INFERIORITY_UPPER_QUANTILE)
formulas.notes: the margin is the one-sided upper percentile of the paired bootstrap of the hybrid-minus-active loss on the frozen admission support

formulas.criterion: abs(margin_global_analytic - margin_global) <= MARGIN_ANALYTIC_TOLERANCE_BITS and margin_global_analytic <= MARGIN_MAX_BITS
formulas.notes: closed-form cross-check of the bootstrap margin; the two must agree within the preregistered tolerance

formulas.criterion: gain_sparse >= GAIN_FLOOR_BITS and min(gain.rare_exact, gain.exact_absent_in_domain) >= GAIN_FLOOR_BITS and (n.rare_exact + n.exact_absent_in_domain) >= MINIMUM_SPARSE_OBSERVATIONS
formulas.notes: the sparse floor pools exactly rare_exact and exact_absent_in_domain, the two strata the generalized channel is allowed to cover; the {selected} placeholder of the inputs resolves to the architecture selected by the frozen TRAIN cross-validation

formulas.expression: gain_sparse_lower_bound = quantile(paired_bootstrap(hand_id, B=BOOTSTRAP_SAMPLES, seed=BOOTSTRAP_SEED) of gain_sparse, NON_INFERIORITY_ALPHA)
formulas.notes: conservative admission form of the sparse floor: the lower paired-bootstrap percentile of the sparse gain must stay above the floor

support-weighted sparse calibration error on the same two strata as the sparse gain floor; the {selected} placeholder of the inputs resolves to the architecture selected by the frozen TRAIN cross-validation
the sparse ceiling is the tighter of the absolute ceiling and the active reference ECE plus the preregistered delta
the frequent-exact route must never degrade the active reference beyond the preregistered bound, in point estimate and in paired upper bound

formulas.expression: hard_reasons(c) = reasons(c) intersect OOD_HARD_REASONS; abstain(c) iff hard_reasons(c) is not empty; high_uncertainty(c) iff hard_reasons(c) is empty and soft_reasons(c) is not empty
formulas.notes: abstention is decided by the hard reason set only; an exact cell absent while every single-feature label is in domain is never decisive

formulas.criterion: route_source(c) equals the first matching row of the route decision table
formulas.expression: route_source(c) = OOD_ABSTAIN if hard_reasons(c) is not empty else ACTIVE_STRONG_SUPPORT if support_exact(c) >= FREQUENT_EXACT_MIN_SUPPORT else GENERALIZED_SPARSE_IN_DOMAIN if feature_in_domain(c) else OOD_ABSTAIN
formulas.notes: the ordered decision table R1..R4 is the single source of the route; the last row is a fail-closed fallback onto OOD_ABSTAIN

formulas.criterion: support_state is the support state declared by the selected route source
formulas.expression: support_state(c) = STRONG_EXACT_SUPPORT if route_source(c) == ACTIVE_STRONG_SUPPORT else SPARSE_IN_DOMAIN if route_source(c) == GENERALIZED_SPARSE_IN_DOMAIN else OOD_ABSTAIN
formulas.notes: support_state mirrors the selected route source so a consumer never re-derives it

formulas.criterion: every held-out decision receives exactly one of the four frozen strata
formulas.expression: stratum(c) = frequent_exact if support_exact(c) >= FREQUENT_EXACT_MIN_SUPPORT else rare_exact if support_exact(c) >= RARE_EXACT_MIN_SUPPORT else exact_absent_in_domain if feature_in_domain(c) else exact_absent_out_of_domain
formulas.notes: the stratum of a decision is a pure function of the fit-fold exact support and of the single-feature in-domain verdict

purpose: preregister, before any closure evaluation, how a preflop response request is routed between the active strong-support model, the generalized sparse in-domain channel and a fail-closed abstention, and how every admission threshold is derived from TRAIN-only out-of-fold evidence

the queried effective stack leaves the calibrated TRAIN stack domain
the queried raise target leaves the calibrated TRAIN sizing domain
the queried to-call / pot price leaves the calibrated TRAIN price domain

the exact context signature is below the calibrated minimum exact-context share

route_decision_table.when: hard_reasons(context) is empty and support_exact >= FREQUENT_EXACT_MIN_SUPPORT

route_sources.definition: answer from the active reference population model, admissible only where the exact context is strongly supported
answer from the learned generalized response channel where the exact context is sparse or absent but every single-feature label stays inside the calibrated domain
fail closed: no route may answer, no probabilities and no sizing are emitted, and the decision is excluded from every predictive gate

runtime_contract.analysis_admissibility_rule: analysis_admissible = (route_source != OOD_ABSTAIN) and probabilities legal and (sizing_provenance present when the selected action is RAISE or JAM)

strata.definition: held-out decisions stratified by the fit-fold support of their exact context signature (exact_context_key): frequent_exact = support >= 20, rare_exact = 1 <= support < 20, exact_absent_in_domain = support == 0 while every single-feature node label is observed in the fit fold, exact_absent_out_of_domain = support == 0 with at least one unseen feature value
